summary: Action plugins work alongside modules, running in the background to do prerequisite work before a module executes. Modules without their own action plugin use the 'normal' action plugin, and you can write custom ones.
questions: What does an action plugin do compared with a module?
What happens for modules that don't have their own action plugin?
Can I write my own action plugin?

answer_card.title: What action plugins are
answer_card.answer_md: Action plugins run with modules and do prerequisite work, usually on the controller, before the module executes. Modules without a dedicated action plugin use the `normal` action plugin. You can create custom action plugins if you need to.
